title: Replace workload guesses with beta request/token/duration/byte distributions (polling, synchronized class starts, retries, Build demand; no double-counting turns)
laws: chunking: aiTurnsPerDauDay counts distinct questions, never chunks; aiAdmissionsPerDauDay counts every chunk as one runtime/token admission event; per-turn tokens aggregate chunk means once
polling: device-sync polls are API requests that raise coreCallsPerDauDay and request-seconds, never AI turns or admissions
retry: measured attempts-per-primary histogram drives providerAttemptMultiplier; retries = attempts - turns, never new logical turns
synchronized class-start: measured peak/mean ratio is a capacity guardrail report, not a uniform spread and not a cost input

Build/offline: one logical Build run across N chunks counts once; chunks remain the admission surface; reconnects are one replay work item each; Build/reconnect are worker demand, never foreground questions
voice: ASR input tokens from capture minutes, TTS output audio bytes from spoken seconds, turn wall-time includes capture + ASR + text + TTS

provenance fail-closed: a beta claim without windowStart/windowEnd/positive activeUsers/daysCaptured is rejected; synthetic profiles are explicit; measured overrides only flow from distribution-kind values
bridge: workloadToCostOverrides emits only the keys the D-075 estimate() accepts, and the projected turns/attempts/core must disagree with the naive chunk count

gates.result: exit 0 — script-tests 124/124 incl. workload-model; qa:continuity/motion/taps; import baseline 3842 files; surface audit; lint; typecheck; npm test 672/672; build

defectsFoundAndFixed.finding: buildAdmissions used summarizeHistogram().total (the observation/run count, 2400) instead of the weighted chunk total (6120). Fixed: admission surface = weighted sum of build-chunks histogram.
Floating-point exactness: 1.095 - 1 asserted equal to 0.095 failed by 1e-17. Changed to tolerance assertions.
